notes.content:
[previewyoutube=YDMOYF9_Q7E;full][/previewyoutube]

The Anniversary Update for Killer Klowns From Outer Space: The Game is here!

Don’t forget to take advantage of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1556100/view/534351647699111832?l=english]DOUBLE XP[/url] event and [url=https://killer-klowns-staging.netlify.app/news/twitch-drops-1year]Twitch Drops[/url] ongoing right now!

[h2]New Klown - Dollie[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42850130/b8310db602c0ec0d372dc0624fbd7302a35a31de.jpg[/img]
Dollie is a larger-than life figure, always at the center of circus mayhem with her oversized striped shoes and vibrant patchwork suit. She delights in crafting elaborate pranks that leave her victims bewildered, like her signature acid pies that explode into a colorful, gooey mess. With a wild mane of hair that defies gravity, Dollie’s infectious laughter echoes through the night, drawing in unsuspecting victims who become the punchline of her chaotic jokes. Her love for slapstick humor knows no bounds, making her an unstoppable force in her twisted carnival of horrors. 

[i]Dollie is a special character skin for the Tank Klown type and is purely cosmetic[/i]

As the alien invasion intensifies, the remaining humans prove to be increasingly formidable. Just in the nick of time, reinforcements descend, and these otherworldly Klowns join the fray, still clad in their spacesuits. This cosmetic bundle offers 5 unique spacesuit designs, each with 11 distinct color variations. 

[i]These items are purely cosmetic and do not affect gameplay.[/i]

Don’t miss out on this limited time offer in the in-game store!

We’ve introduced 12 new Challenge books for Human and Klown players to complete. 

That’s over 80 new challenges in total!

Accompanying these new challenge books is over 40 new cosmetics as well as XP rewards to help you level up!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42850130/a640df29215146a77c83482a643b125b471db648.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*]Slightly increased Laser Beamer cottonization damage
[/list]

[*]Various Crash Fixes
[*]Fixed an issue where the party host’s Quickplay lobby could appear as a black screen with only the lobby HUD elements displayed
[*]Fixed an issue where a duplicate of the cap of a cocoon could appear twice when a Human escapes from a cocoon
[*]Fixed an issue where Humans and Klowns were spawning too close to each other on Waterfront Pier

[*]Fixed an issue where Human footstep SFX would not play for a player that joined a match in progress

[*]Fixed an exploit where Klowns could move Gas Cans
[*]Fixed an issue where Klown skin and makeup could appear faded
[*]Fixed an issue where the Klown Jump map Fog of War could not be uncovered on certain areas across various maps
[*]Fixed an issue where a Human could be Klowntalitied and cocooned simultaneously
[*]Fixed an issue where Gobstopper Flail attacks would not damage Humans
[*]Fixed an issue where the Gobstopper Flail would not always extend during an attack combo
[*]Fixed an issue where the third swing in a melee attack combo would not occur while repeatedly hitting the attack button 
[*]Fixed an issue where the Klowntality Menu could not open while the LOL Trick was active
[*]Fixed an issue where Klown Trick cooldowns could appear reset after canceling the Pizza Box transformation in a Private Match

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42850130/7312e1e5f8474e3d9e191022f5a12cc774399333.png[/img]

[h3]New In-Game Store![/h3]
We are happy to announce the new Killer Klowns From Outer Space: The Game digital store! Premium DLC's are now conveniently located and purchasable in-game using Tickets. You can navigate to the store straight from the main menu!

[b]How do I find the store?[/b]
Start Killer Klowns From Outer Space: The Game, and from the main menu, navigate to the Store button on the bottom-right of your screen.

[b]How do I purchase Tickets?[/b]
On the main menu -OR- in the store, navigate to the Ticket button on the top-right of your screen to open the tickets interface-- this is essentially your store wallet. You can then select an option for how many Tickets you would like to purchase.

[b]Can I gift Tickets and/or Premium DLC?[/b]
At this time, Tickets and Premium DLC cannot be gifted.

[b]What happened to the old Premium Cosmetic DLC locations?[/b]
Premium Cosmetic DLCs located on other platforms have been de-listed, and all Premium Cosmetic DLCs will be available through the in-game store going forward.

[b]What if I already bought Premium DLC before the store was implemented?[/b]
No change here-- you will still have your Premium DLC purchases.

[b]Are in-game store purchases refundable?[/b]
At this time, there are no refunds on in-game store purchases.

[b]How do I stay up-to-date about new Premium DLC?[/b]
Outside of checking the store, you can stay up-to-date about new Premium DLC and other news/events on our social channels and Discord!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42850130/fc08085d49a54419937c2fa7f298f2ce57459cc2.png[/img]
[h2]New DLC Cosmetics[/h2]
[h3]Human Summer Outfit Pack[/h3]
The sun is out, and the beaches of Crescent Cove are brimming with energy! Gear up for the Klown invasion with this assortment of summer themed human cosmetics! This DLC includes summer themed tops, bottoms, hats, and eyewear. All items are purely cosmetic and do not alter gameplay.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2921250/Killer_Klowns_From_Outer_Space_Human_Summer_Outfit_Pack/?curator_clanid=42850130

[h3]Infernal Ranger[/h3]
As a Dark Jester, more than just laughter is needed to satisfy this Klown. Nothing is more funny to Slappy than the sounds of humans fleeing in terror. Slappy is a special character skin for the Tracker Klown Type and is only cosmetic.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2921240/Killer_Klowns_From_Outer_Space_Infernal_Tracker__Slappy/?curator_clanid=42850130

[h2]Changes and Improvements[/h2]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]
[*]The Matchmaking Preference System is now available 
[*]Added an accessible In-Game Friends List to the Pause Menu while in a match
[*]In the private match menu, the Map Selection buttons are now clickable 
[*]Disabled door interactions while doors are mid-animation
[*]Updated Klownpocalypse VFX
[*]Player HUD will now be hidden at the end of a match
[/list]
[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*]Introduced a delay to stamina regeneration for all Klowns and Humans
[*]Increased total stamina pools and stamina regeneration for all Klowns and Humans
[*][b]Adjusted spawn points so Humans and Klowns should no longer spawn or resurrect near each other[/b]
[/list]
[h3]Humans[/h3]
[list]
[*]Made adjustments and fixes to the Human Archetype stats
[*]Increased drop rates on Hand of Fate card rarities. Players will now have increased odds for better drops
[*]Adjusted and polished animations for:
[*]Human movement while crouching
[*]Gas Can interactions
[*]Bunker Keypad interactions
[/list]
[h3]Klowns[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Increased EXP Rewards for:[/b]
[*]Cocooning a Human
[*]Assisting in cocooning a Human
[*]Hooking a cocoon containing a live Human
[*]Hitting a Human with a cocoon
[*][b]Adjusted and polished animations for:[/b]
[*]Klown Mallet combo
[*]Klown Raygun
[*]Invisible Car left and right turning 
[*]Improved Lackey pathing so Lackeys are less likely to get stuck
[*]Bouncecaster projectiles will now explode upon impact with Lackeys
[*]Added some visual flashing to the progress bar while cottonizing an objective 
[*]Added a camera angle for Shoe customization
[*]Adjusted SFX of the Mallet Charge attack
[/list]
[h3]Klown Types[/h3]
[list]
[*]Klown Type “Trapper” renamed to “Hunter”
[*]Game balance was hindered noticeably with Klown Traps, and at the end of the day it is about making the best game experience for everyone. The name change came to better represent the Klown Type.
[*]Increased the Tank Klown’s walk and run speed 
[*]Increased the Hunter Klown’s total stamina pool
[*]Increased the Ranger Klown’s walk and run speed
[*]Reduced the Stamina Drain on the Brawler Klown
[*]Adjusted the Brawler Klown’s Stamina stat display
[*]Reduced the speed of backwards sprinting on Klowns
[*]Reduced the speed penalty from light stuns on Klowns
[/list]
[h3]Klown Weapons[/h3]
[list]
[*]Increased damage of the Gobstopper Flail’s primary melee attacks
[*]Improved hit detection on the Gobstopper Flail
[/list]
[h3]Klown Tricks[/h3]
[list]
[*]Increased LOL Trick’s healing speed 
[*]Adjusted the LOL Trick to start its duration timer after the casting animation completes
[*]Adjusted the Balloon Dog Trick to start its duration timer after the casting animation completes
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[u][b]General[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Various crash fixes
[*]Fixed an issue that was causing Challenges to not track or complete while playing on dedicated servers
[*]Fixed an issue where players would appear to fall through the floor when vaulting or silently crossing windows
[*]Addressed an issue that was causing lobbies to have more than 7 Humans in a game
[*]Fixed an issue where players joining a match in-progress would incorrectly see the Bridge escape barricaded after it had already been opened
[*]Fixed an issue where players joining a match in-progress would incorrectly see the Bunker escape as usable, after it had already been used
[*]Fixed an issue where players were not able to save their Party Privacy settings 
[*]Fixed an issue where players could take fall damage upon spawning or respawning
[*]Fixed an issue that was causing interaction animations to not play properly for hosts
[*]Fixed interact animation not playing for the host when stopped and quickly started
[*]Fixed an issue where a Human’s character model would appear in front of a hiding spot for a moment before exiting the hiding spot 
[*]Fixed an issue where interaction UI could get stuck on a player’s screen if the interaction was interrupted or moved out of range
[*]Fixed and polished various audio issues
[*]Fixed an issue where the Portal escape VFX would only appear for the host of the match
[*]Fixed an issue where players were able to rotate their characters in the customization menu even after they had let go of the left-mouse-button
[*]Fixed an issue where players were not seeing voice transcriptions if they were not the host of the lobby
[*]Fixed an issue where voice transcription text was popping up from audio that was playing out of range of players
[/list]
[h3]Klowns[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where Klowns were able to see Flashlights when in the Klown Jump View Mode
[*]Fixed an issue where the Pentashot would not properly cottonize Humans while they were being grabbed by a Lackey 
[*]Fixed an issue where the firing animation for the Gigaray would sometimes not properly play 
[*]Fixed an issue where Klowns were not able to use the Pizza Box Trick in certain areas
[*]Fixed an issue where Klowns could get soft-locked if they tried to use the Pizza Box Trick while picking up a cocoon at the same time
[*]Fixed an issue that was causing a Klown’s VOIP to stop working properly after they used the Pizza Box Trick
[*]Fixed an issue where Klowns could not see other Klown’s name tags
[*]Fixed an issue where sometimes while trying to Klown Jump indoors, Klowns were not receiving a prompt telling them you cannot jump indoors 
[*]Fixed an issue where Klowns could get EXP for hitting a dead Human body with a thrown cocoon
[*]Fixed an issue where if the Tank was carrying a cocoon, the “Drop” icon would flash
[/list]
[h3]Humans[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where Humans would not earn XP or Challenge progression when hitting or shooting a Klown and causing them to drop a cocoon
[*]Fixed an issue where Humans would get stuck after being grabbed by a Lackey and then stunned by a Klown
[*]Fixed an issue where the Human’s walk animation would not play correctly after being Lured out of a Boat
[*]Fixed an issue where ammo amounts would be randomized if ammo was dropped from inventory
[*]Fixed an issue where Human cameras could get stuck zoomed in after crouching and aiming using a Revolver or Shotgun
[*]Fixed an issue where Human escape animations were playing incorrectly 
[*]Fixed an issue that was causing Humans to see incorrect camera angles while hiding in a hiding spot 
[*]Fixed an issue where stamina would continue to drain while hiding in a hiding spot
[*]Fixed an issue where Humans would see remaining health after they had been killed
[*]Fixed an issue where dead Human players could not spectate Bot Humans
[*]Fixed an issue where Humans would not receive a hitmarker for hitting Lackeys with guns
[*]Fixed an issue where, as a Human dropping your melee items could sometimes make them stand up vertically 
[*]Fixed an issue where Humans would appear standing up after Emoting while waiting in the Boat escape
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.1.4
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42850130/25f873772264778c854f3a491c8f40452d115049.png[/img]

[i]To clear up any confusion that may occur from the patch version number; we are skipping 1.1.3 and releasing it as 1.1.4 instead.
This was done in order to implement several necessary fixes into this build. We will remember how to count properly in the future.[/i]

[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
[*] Various Crash Fixes
[*] Various fixes and improvements to address cheating and exploiting
[*] Various fixes, improvements, and optimizations to the matchmaking, crossplay, and party systems
[*] Various fixes and improvements to several map locations and escapes
[*] Fixed an issue where players were able to interact with objects while stunned
[*] Made adjustments to the timing of several animations to be more aligned with the gameplay
[/list]
[h1]Humans[/h1]
[list]
[*] Addressed an issue that was causing certain items to be unable to be picked up
[*] Reduced the duration of the Energy Drink
[*] Fixed an issue where the Ice Cream Truck Escapes would sometimes allow the player to be killed even after they have already escaped
[*] Fixed an issue where the Ice Cream Truck Escapes objective markers would not appear for players that have resurrected recently
[*] Fixed an issue where vaulting would not drain stamina
[*] Fixed an issue where players could enter the Bunker without escaping
[*] Fixed an issue where players could continue to interact with an escape objective even after taking damage or failing the QTE
[*] Fixed an issue that was allowing too many players to enter the Boat Escape
[/list]


[h1]Klowns[/h1]
[list]
[*] Downed Humans will now get cocooned faster when being cottonized by non-raygun based weapons
[*] Klowns can now push lackeys out of the way
[*] Increased amount of Cotton Candy Cocoons that spawn on the map
[*] Made improvements to the Boxing Gloves and Mallet’s hit detection
[*] Added collision to Cotton Candy Cocoons to prevent them from being placed at certain escape locations
[*] Addressed several issues that were causing escape objectives to not be cottonized with certain weapons
[*] Fixed an issue where Klowns were able to cocoon Humans while the Human is being Klowntalitied
[*] Fixed an issue where Klowns were able to cocoon Humans while the Human has already escaped
[*] Fixed an issue where Klowns were sometimes unable to break certain windows
[/list]

notes.title: Thank You For an Incredible First Week!!!
notes.content:
THANK YOU CRESCENT COVE COMMUNITY!!!!

We are truly overwhelmed by your positive reception and support of Killer Klowns from Outer Space.

Who knew there were so many fans that shared our childhood love of criminally underrated horror films.Thank you for all the support, feedback, reviews and - most importantly - the trust that you’ve shown us as a team. We know you’ve got a lot of questions and we’ll get to that; first, we want to do some *light* bragging. 

Ahem.

Reading your comments, watching the social media channel rocket upward and seeing the press loving this as much as we do has been…well there aren’t really words. You all have made this endeavor such a joy for us, and we want to make sure we return the favor ten-fold come launch. How much hooting and hollering have you all done? Have a look:


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42850130/6c32d2a6ac44ddd731a969e4a5c13f8cc6418193.png[/img]

[h3]HOW CAN YOU HELP US?[/h3]

The console pages are now up and LIVE! Please wishlist them and here on Steam as well. This is the #1 way you can help the team here and to share your excitement about the announcement.

[h3]YOUR QUESTIONS[/h3]

Now for those questions, a lot of you are asking how this whole craaaazy game came to be. We have a new blog out with the Chiodo Brothers, the film’s creators themselves, How does a film become a game? Read on [url=https://www.killerklownsthegame.com/news-update/how-does-a-film-become-a-game]LINK[/url]. 
We have lots of blogs sharing more info about the game so check them out too while you’re there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42850130/a83c688f1590c8635f0ceb48d847543bed150552.jpg[/img]

The question we’re getting a lot as well is about how multiplayer works on the consoles. KKFOS is coming to Steam, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, Xbox Series X|S and Xbox One. [u]Our game is a premium title, not free-to-play, and will require an active PS Plus or Xbox Live Gold subscription in order to play online – unless something changes on the first-party side before we release, of course. 

Another question is about microtransactions. We will never be pay-to-win. You will never be able to get any gameplay advantage over other players with real money. What we will have is purely cosmetic items for visual customization of your characters. More details on the customization and progression later![/u]

You’ll have lots of opportunities so ask and learn more in our [url=https://discord.gg/killerklownsgame]Discord[/url] and on the Steam forums; and judging by your reactions, there will be a LOT of questions.  Check out some of our favorites below from the announcement at Gamescom. Huge thanks to:

8BE
David Kang
Draven Mayberry
Runebee
3C Films
Centerstrain01

[previewyoutube=RW7gXi2ca10;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]SIGN UP FOR THE BETA[/h3]

If you want to get in on the action before launch, we invite you to sign up for the [url=https://devolver.typeform.com/kkfos-beta?_ga=2.250919872.791719059.1661869571-739549760.1661284692&typeform-source=www.killerklownsthegame.com]BETA here[/url], you will get an email closer to launch inviting you to [url=https://discord.gg/killerklownsgame]join the Discord[/url] and receive your key. In the meantime, please follow our social channels below. We’re told we’re “making you all go ding dong mode.” So, carry on with that. We’ll see you on the internet
